notes.pokemon: pokemon/manifest.json paths are relative to this assets/ directory and have no extension: append .png (texture) / .json (TexturePacker atlas). Files are byte-identical copies using PokéRogue's own names (e.g. 6-mega-x). Like PokéRogue's 'Mixed Animated' sprite set, the animated images/pokemon/exp/ atlas is copied when one exists; report.staticSprites lists fronts that are a single still frame.
notes.items: items-manifest.json: { atlas: 'items', frame } refers to items.png/items.json; { file } is a standalone PNG from PokeAPI/sprites; null = no icon in either source.
notes.audio: audio/manifest.json: bgm[name] = { file, loop } with PokéRogue's playBgm names (loop = loop-point seconds from its getBgmLoopPoint, 0 = whole track, null = play once); se[key] = { file, duration } with its playSound keys (se/…, ui/…). Files keep PokéRogue's paths below audio/.
notes.teraShards: PokéRogue has per-type icons (<type>_tera_shard frames) and a templated name '{{teraType}} Tera Shard' (see i18n itemTemplates.TERA_SHARD); there is no generic TERA_SHARD icon or name.
